content.text:
The M1 weather check is failing because the `temp` covariate (from column `temp_ecmwf_00z`) currently has a `lead_hours` value of **30 hours**, but the M1 gate requires **at least 40 hours**.

To make Task 7 pass the M1 weather check, you need to set the `lead_hours` value to **40** (or higher).

This will ensure that all forecast hours for the temperature covariate are published at least 40 hours before their valid time, meeting the M1 milestone gate requirement (09:00 on D-1).
